correctness.rationale: The complex was reconstructed from two independent published descriptions. The 54x28 integral relation matrix has Smith diagonal 1 repeated 27 times, proving H1 is infinite cyclic. The winding functional vanishes on every face triangle and equals 1 on every missing triangle in cyclic orientation. Exact exhaustive replay confirms all 84 triples, orbit sizes, and translation action. value.rationale: K^3_9 is the unique nine-vertex non-sphere combinatorial 3-manifold and a canonical cyclic minimal triangulation. Identifying every missing triangle as a primitive generator gives a complete shortest-cycle description of its infinite cyclic first homology, while the four orbit types expose how the cyclic combinatorics encode the S^1 direction. This is a natural structural invariant of a canonical object rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
